brief_rationale: The model actively elicited biliary red flags, identified insulin/meal intake risk (RC4), clarified that gallbladder surgery had not occurred and that CT suggested surgery but was not a completed procedure (RC3/HO1), corrected the family's misconception that discharge medicines could dissolve gallstones (RC7/HO2), and dynamically reprioritized diabetes medication safety when poor intake and insulin mis-dosing risk emerged (HO3). It delivered a bounded closure with explicit emergency thresholds and pending surgical decision (HO4). No serious or minor responsibility-chain error was observed; all RC items were met at least adequately. Two distinct high-order points (HO1 and HO2) were fully triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact, meeting the strict Perfect criteria.
